about_the_game: Dive into the past with "The MisAdventures of Xenos: Legacy Edition," a DLC that celebrates the one-year anniversary of the beloved RPG by reintroducing the classic RPG Maker VX Ace version. Experience the original charm that laid the groundwork for the current RPG Maker MV edition. This is not just a throwback—it's a treasure trove of memories, with enhanced features and content that bridge a decade of adventure and storytelling. Enjoy the vintage visuals, classic gameplay mechanics, and re-live the journey of Xenos with a touch of modern finesse. Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the series, this DLC packs a nostalgic punch while offering a fresh perspective on the epic tale.
